transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: Welcome to the team. How's your first week going?

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: It's been a lot to take in, but everyone's been helpful. Trying to understand all the moving pieces.

transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: Yeah, there's a lot going on. The big thing right now is the Platform Migration. The Technical Lead is leading that. You'll be working closely with them.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: I've seen the Technical Lead in the standups. What's my role in the migration?

transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: We want you to focus on the Checkout Service. The Backend Lead has been leading that, but could use a second senior engineer. The goal is to have the new architecture ready by Q2.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: Got it. I noticed there's an Auth Token Refresh Bug that keeps coming up. Is that related?

transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: Yes, it's a blocker. The auth flow between services is fragile. We need someone with your experience to help untangle it. The Backend Lead can bring you up to speed.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: Makes sense. What about the Frontend Lead and Platform Lead?

transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: The Frontend Lead owns the Metrics Dashboard. The Platform Lead handles DevOps and CI/CD. You'll want to sync with the Platform Lead on deployment work for Checkout.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: This is really helpful. Any advice for ramping up?

transcript.speaker: Engineering Manager
transcript.text: Honestly, just absorb as much context as you can. Sit in on the standups, read the ADRs, and don't be afraid to ask questions. The team is great about knowledge sharing.
